name: Multiverse Hub
author: nickohlmeier
description: Adds a 'Change Game' option to the PC that warps the player into a small hand-built 'gauntlet' zone for an integrated source game, populated with that game's real extracted content. Pilot: a two-battle Animon gauntlet (Naruto -> Kuramamode) using species already merged into AnimeFusionMerge. New maps are built as fully synthetic RPG::Map objects at runtime (no .rxdata files), following GhostBase_PlayerHousing's proven pattern, so nothing here touches any base game file.
